name: Hidden Valley Camp
description_short: Overnight camp in Freedom, Maine. Most campers stay for a roughly four-week session, and there are teen programs in wilderness travel, advanced arts and counselor training. Tuition covers almost everything. Some travel to and from camp and optional riding lessons cost extra.

warnings: The teen program listings are unclear. Adventures and AWACs say '1st and 2nd Session', which could mean the program runs in each session or that one price covers both. Arts and Apprentices say '1st or 2nd Session'.
The early registration discount (10%) ends October 31, a little over two weeks after today (2026-10-13). Without a year given, it most likely means Oct 31, 2026, for the 2027 season.
Half sessions are for new campers only. AWACs need to be former campers, and Apprentices need at least one summer at HVC.
'Registration is open' does not mean every session still has room.
